description: Engineer's Goggles: see speed, stress and contents.

pages.title: Goggles
pages.text:
**Engineer's Goggles** are worn on your head and show information when you look at a block: stress impact, capacity and speed of kinetic parts, and what is in tanks and basins.\
\
They also show a steam boiler's power level, and many add-on blocks give extra readouts through them. Aviator's Goggles work the same way.
